dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So how is the pay calculated?

dialogues.speaker: Shikun
dialogues.text: Nah, it's not, we're way too close to worry about formalities like that!

dialogues.speaker: Shikun
dialogues.text: After we helped them out, the neighbors treated us to dinner and we had a few drinks together! That counts as payment!

dialogues.speaker: Shikun
dialogues.text: Yeah, I even moved a bunch of clothes and books for Deyin a couple of days ago, and he made some killer egg soup!

dialogues.speaker: Shikun
dialogues.text: If you have some time, you should go chat with him and let him tell you stories about Chenyu Vale!
